result.instructions: Storage is .chisel/store. Branch on status. Call analyze when status is no_data. Call diff_impact after edits, before running tests: since=main covers committed work; in a git worktree pass worktree_root. This process is stdio MCP (chisel serve-mcp).

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Build the snapshot once per project: code units, tests, test-to-code edges, git history. Then use update after edits. force on more than 300 files returns auto_queued: poll job_status.

force.description: Re-analyze every file even if unchanged.

shard.description: Shard name for monorepos (CHISEL_SHARDS). Omit to route by path.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Tests that reach the given files or functions, ranked. For the edits you just made, diff_impact reads them from git instead.

files.description: Changed file paths, relative to the project.

functions.description: Count only direct edges to these function names.

depth.description: Call depth: 1 direct only; 2-3 add tests of callers (default 2).

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: suggest_tests
tools.description: Before or after changing one file: which tests to run for it, ranked, with a source per row (hybrid, direct, import_graph, co_change, static_require, working_tree, fallback). Grep finds names, not who calls what.

fallback_to_all.description: When nothing links to the file, rank every test by name similarity.

working_tree.description: Also read untracked files (new files not yet analyzed).

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: churn
tools.description: How often a file, or one function in it, changed: commits, authors, lines, last change.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

unit_name.description: One function or class in the file.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: ownership
tools.description: Original authors of a file's lines (git blame). For current maintainers use who_reviews.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: coupling
tools.description: Files that change together with this one (git co-change) or import it. Co-change needs history with small multi-file commits.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

min_count.description: Minimum shared commits for a co-change partner (default 3).

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: risk_map
tools.description: Files ranked by risk: churn, coupling, coverage gap, single-author code, flaky tests. Fields that are zero or empty are omitted. Check _meta.uniform_components before trusting a score.

exclude_tests.description: Leave out test files and code under tests/, fixtures/, testdata/ (default true).

proximity_adjustment.description: Lower the coverage gap of files a few imports from tested code (default true).

coverage_mode.description: 'line' (default) weights units by size; 'unit' counts each unit once.

auto_update.description: Run update first if the snapshot is stale.

exclude_new_file_boost.description: Do not boost files that have no history and no tests.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: stale_tests
tools.description: Tests whose edges point at code that changed or no longer exists since the last analyze.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Commits that touched a file, newest first.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: who_reviews
tools.description: Active maintainers of a file from recent commits, as reviewer suggestions. For original authors use ownership.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: record_result
tools.description: Store a test pass or fail. Feeds failure rate and flakiness into suggest_tests and risk_map. Call after each test run.

test_id.description: Test id as suggest_tests returns it, e.g. 'tests/test_app.py:test_foo'.

tools.name: diff_impact
tools.description: Call after editing, before running tests: which tests your changes reach, ranked (direct callers, then callers of callers). Default: uncommitted work on main, all work since the merge-base on a branch; since=main for committed work.

ref.description: Plain diff against this ref instead, e.g. HEAD~1.

since.description: Score every change since the merge-base of this ref and HEAD, committed or not (e.g. main).

working_tree.description: Also scan imports of untracked files, not just their names.

auto_update.description: Run update first when changed files are missing from the snapshot.

depth.description: Call depth: 1 direct only; 2-3 add tests of callers (default 2).

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Re-index only changed files and new commits; much faster than analyze. With worktree_root, refreshes that worktree's overlay (main's snapshot is never written).

shard.description: Shard name for monorepos (CHISEL_SHARDS). Omit to route by path.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Snapshot counts and the co-change threshold. Use to check that analyze ran, or why a tool returns nothing.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: optimize_storage
tools.description: Rewrite the snapshot without expired locks.

tools.name: test_gaps
tools.description: Code units no test reaches, highest churn first: what to test next.

exclude_tests.description: Leave out test files and code under tests/, fixtures/, testdata/ (default true).

auto_update.description: Run update first if the snapshot is stale.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: triage
tools.description: First call for an audit or refactor: the riskiest files with their test gaps and stale tests, in one response.

exclude_tests.description: Leave out test files and code under tests/, fixtures/, testdata/ (default true).

auto_update.description: Run update first if the snapshot is stale.

exclude_new_file_boost.description: Do not boost files that have no history and no tests.

worktree_root.description: Absolute path of your git worktree: answer for it.

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Run analyze or update in the background and get a job_id at once; poll job_status. Use when a call could time out.

shard.description: Shard name for monorepos (CHISEL_SHARDS). Omit to route by path.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: State of a start_job job: queued, running, completed (with result), failed (with error) or not_found.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Ask a running job to stop. It stops between files; poll job_status to confirm.

tools.name: acquire_file_lock
tools.description: Claim a file before editing so other agents see it. Put your plan or status in purpose. A refused claim returns the holder, purpose and expiry. Advisory only.

file_path.description: File to lock, relative to the project.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. Other agents see it.

purpose.description: What you are doing. Shown to other agents.

tools.name: release_file_lock
tools.description: Release your lock on a file. If it is not yours, returns the holder and the reason.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. Other agents see it.

tools.name: refresh_file_lock
tools.description: Extend your lock while you are still editing.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. Other agents see it.

tools.name: check_file_lock
tools.description: Who holds the lock on a file, why, and until when.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.

tools.name: check_locks
tools.description: Lock conflicts for several files at once. Call before multi-file work.

tools.name: list_file_locks
tools.description: Active locks, optionally for one agent: what other agents are working on.

tools.name: issues
tools.description: Test failures Chisel captured from test runs (no call needed to record them), deduplicated, newest first, each with its top suspect. Open only unless all=true.

since.description: Only issues seen since: 30m, 12h, 7d or YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: issue
tools.description: One issue in full: error, location, suspects (covered code that changed since the test last passed, with reasons), occurrences, excerpt, and the fix once it passes.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: What broke in a file or function and what fixed it: issues where it was a suspect, the failing test, the failure site, or part of the fix.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project.
